doc.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20

title: Sunset Syncopators and recordings with Emile Barnes
summary: He formed the Sunset Syncopators with Paul Barnes and has recorded with others.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Well, Paul and I, Paul Barnes and I, we got a band, Sunset Syncopator, and we've done a lot of work here, too. There's a lot of different, you know, outfits.
You've made some records with different people, too. Emile Barnes. Yeah, I mean, when we were born, yeah.
Oh, yeah. We just lived together. Bill Rossman. Yeah, we're watching.
